section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses demographic effects on women's body image, specifically examining relationships between age, socioeconomic status (SES), and body image. The authors review mixed findings from prior studies on age-related body dissatisfaction and note that few studies have investigated SES relationships with body image among Western women. The section concludes by indicating that the authors included a measure of educational status as a proxy for SES in their own study, though no specific study number or detailed methodology is provided in this excerpt.
